luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local bank = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "vault")
check(bank ~= nil, "wrap vault")
local id = bank.getUuid()
check(id ~= nil, "uuid")
check(bank.getBalance() == 0, "new vault is empty")
local found = false
for _, v in ipairs(vault.list()) do if v == id then found = true end end
check(found, "vault.list has it")
check(vault.getBalance(id) == 0, "vault.getBalance")
check(not pcall(bank.payout, 1), "payout without player refused")
print("PASS vault")
